text:
maria: quick thread to lock SKU/burst defaults for the Q3 Dedicated roadmap. Need decisions today: SKU names, burst window by tier, carryover policy, and safe autoscale defaults.

ajay: propose SKUs = launch(1GPU-eq)/team(4)/scale(32). Keep names short for Console.

ben: infra note: cold-starts for large models ~2-4min; KV drain ~30s. recommend scale_down_cooldown=180s and scale_up_smoothing=45s.

tal: UX: show a "remaining USD-minutes" badge + ledger download. Carryover must be explicit opt-in on purchase.

sophia: finance/legal: canonical billing unit = USD-minutes. carryover allowed only with opt-in + audit. Pilot for scale only.

ben: minimal feature-flagged config we can ship:
```
sku_defaults:
  launch: {gpu:1, burst:10m}
  team:   {gpu:4, burst:30m}
  scale:  {gpu:32, burst:12h, carryover_opt_in:true}
autoscale:
  scale_up_smooth:45s
  scale_down_cooldown:180s
  soft_quota_default:true
```

ajay: prioritization: (1) soft-quota + throttle UX, (2) ledger + counter, (3) tiered windows, (4) carryover pilot. Rollout behind feature flags.

maria: agreed. Action items: Ben -> dev estimate + risk by Mon EOD; Ajay -> pricing bands + SLOs; Tal -> Console mock Tue; Sophia -> opt-in wording Tue. ops-bot: create calendar event for follow-up.

ops-bot: meeting created "Dedicated Burst Lock" Wed 10:00. Invites sent.

maria: locking these defaults for the roadmap unless objections within 24h. :thumbsup:
